options.name: maxWebContentLength
options.label: Maximum Processing Length for Web Content (0 = no limit)

options.name: SearXNGInstance
options.label: SearXNG Instance (optional, must support JSON API)

options.name: userAgent
options.label: User Agent
options.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/118.0.5993.90 Safari/537.36

tools.name: read_website
tools.description: Browse to a URL and return Title/Desc, page text and images (alts+srcs), and a Links section. Output is capped at {config.maxWebContentLength} characters; truncating body as needed.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: The URL of the web page to get the content of.

tools.name: run_web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return a list of URLs with brief snippets. If more detail is needed, URLs can be read with read_website.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query to look up on the web.

tools.name: download_video
tools.description: Download an online video using YT-DLP to the user's desktop, returning YT-DLP's output.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: The URL of the video to download.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Downloads a file from the internet using cURL and saves it to the provided location.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The full path of the file to write to. Supports environment variables like %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, etc.

parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: The URL of the file to download.
